summary: Iteration 83 regression after emergency prod-saturation fix: (a) _ensure_indexes now runs _create_all() in 2 passes to recover any index that hit the 64-cap during pass1 (notably active_1), (b) _cached_count uses estimated_document_count() for empty/{active:True} queries to prevent COLLSCAN storms on the admin unfiltered total. Ran 22 pytest tests against preview URL covering /api/version marker, admin default+scope=all (estimate path) + scope=all filtered (exact count_documents path), sorts/filters/phone-search/bucket=ozonetel, caller default (own-book exact count on user_id partial index) with desc-sorted verification, group_counts (lead_stage & user_id), same-day merge (create/merge/new phone), and Ozonetel CDR (create + repeat ucid dedupe). ALL 22 PASSED in 9.39s. No 500/504s.

test_results.TestVersion (1): PASS — build=2026-06-db-consolidation+same-day-merge, leads_index_count=16 == expected 16, indexes_consolidated=true (confirms 2-pass build recovered active_1).
test_results.TestAdminLeads (8): PASS — default list fast (<20s), scope=all total via estimated_document_count resolved to sensible ~120k+, scope=all&lead_stage=Contacted (filtered) also resolved to a real non-negative int via count_documents (not stuck at -1), sorts (create_date/-create_date/lead_stage) OK, lead_stage filter OK, date range filter OK, phone search OK, bucket=ozonetel OK.
test_results.TestCallerLeads (3): PASS — caller11 default list <20s, own-book total resolved to exact int, items desc-sorted by create_dt.
test_results.TestGroupCounts (2): PASS — group_by=lead_stage and user_id both under 15s with non-empty response.
test_results.TestSameDayMerge (4): PASS — TEST_iter83_* webhook created, 1st POST creates leadA (merged_same_day=false), 2nd same-phone returns merged_same_day=true / merged_into=leadA, different phone creates leadB. Cleaned up.
test_results.TestOzonetelCDR (2): PASS — new NotAnswered CDR returned 200 in <6s and auto-created lead; repeat with same ucid updated same call_event and lead_id (no duplicate). Cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: 2-pass _ensure_indexes is a solid mitigation for the 64-index-cap race — pass1 creates lean set, drop stale frees slots, pass2 re-creates any cap-skipped index. Confirmed empirically: leads_index_count=16/16 and indexes_consolidated=true.

estimated_document_count() branch in _cached_count is correctly gated to {active:True} and empty queries only — filtered path (verified with lead_stage=Contacted) still uses count_documents on partial indexes, so exact counts are preserved where they matter.
Minor: consider logging pass1-vs-pass2 index-creation results at INFO so ops can detect the cap-race in future without needing /api/version deltas.
estimate can be ~0.02% higher than active-only in prod (includes inactive) — as documented in the request. Callers/consumers should not treat unfiltered total as exact.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_iter83_* webhook, 2 leads via webhook, 1 Ozonetel CDR lead — all deleted in module-scoped cleanup fixture. Uses random phone numbers not in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter83 regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter83_2pass_index_and_est_count.py is self-contained: version marker, admin/caller leads (estimate + exact paths), group_counts, same-day merge, Ozonetel CDR. All 22 passed in 9.39s. Preview data is small/cached — absolute timings are not prod-representative; asserts prioritize correctness + no 500/504 + total resolves (not -1 forever). The 2-pass index build and estimated_document_count changes did not regress any leads/counts/merge/CDR flow.
